messages.subject: RApache + RoR
parts:
Hello,

I followed this tutorial (http://nsaunders.wordpress.com/2010/04/19/
getting-your-web-application-and-rapache-to-talk-to-each-other/) and
was successful in doing it.

I think this union RApache with RoR is very interesting, because
gather powerful statistical analysis tools with powerful web-
application creation tools. In the end of the article, the author
mentioned that this integration could be better done taking advantage
of MVC. However, I can't see how this could be achieved since the
Model and Controller layers are written in Ruby, and I can't imagine
how to gather RApache and Ruby itself, I believe it's not possible.

The author also mentioned that would be interesting to keep R Scripts
in rails root folder, so as it's not public. I believe this could be
one way to keep R codes strictly on server, but don't know how to do
this too.

In short, I'm trying to figure out a way to create a "clean"
application, following MVC pattern, with R scripts separate from View
layer.

Have someone already dealt with it?

Many thanks!

Cheers,

- Joao Daniel
